note_lr: Peak 3e-5, warmup 100, floor 5e-6 as r4/r5. Cosine spans the fixed 2400-update horizon, so rungs 300/900/2400 are prefixes of one trajectory. A resume without Adam state re-warms over 100 updates.
note_ema: Decay .99 instead of r5's .999: at .999 a 300-update EMA is close to a flat mean of the whole rung, including the first post-surgery updates.
note_surgery: Source is the ported master (beatfcn-r5-ported.pt, 321.6M, vocab 1904): 391 of its 395 tensors came straight from the released noteforge r5, the 3 vocabulary layers are aligned field-by-field, control_ids is reordered to the 7 knobs this repo trains. Depth 16->8 (even pattern, keeps layers 0,2,4,6,9,11,13,15) plus decoder FFN 3584->1792: measured 176,590,855 parameters. Encoder FFN is untouched because apply_surgery does not support it.
note_kd: Teacher is the same ported master, uncut (321.6M). Teacher and student therefore share vocabulary 1904 by construction, so evolve_finetune's KD guard passes without any remap. alpha 0.5, T 2.0 as the original C10 intent.
